text: At its meeting on February 20, 2026, the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee considered Item RD1.2 and made recommendations to Board of Directors, CreateTO. Summary from the report (February 5, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO This report provides information respecting the 2025 performance appraisal for the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO.
The Board of Directors, CreateTO referred Item RA24.4, headed 2025 Performance Appraisal - Chief Executive Officer, to the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee for further consideration.
